# MonoForge — Complete AI Agent Technical Reference (llms-full.txt)
> https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app | Comprehensive schema, 22 modular plugins, 30+ SVG/Canvas visualizations, 6-Act Contribution Story, Terminal Profile Kit & ASCII Portrait, Project README Studio, 47 verified social platforms, and URL hydration instructions.

## 1. Zod Schema Specification (TypeScript)

```typescript
import { z } from 'zod';

export const UserSettingsSchema = z.object({
  github: z.string().default(''),
  name: z.string().optional().default(''),
  role: z.string().optional().default(''),
  bio: z.string().optional().default(''),
  location: z.string().optional().default(''),
  pronouns: z.string().optional().default(''),
  status: z.string().optional().default(''),
});

export const SettingsSchema = z.object({
  user: UserSettingsSchema.default({ github: '' }),
  theme: z.enum(['dark', 'light', 'auto']).default('dark'),
  accentColor: z.string().default('#f59e0b'),
  badgeStyle: z.enum(['for-the-badge', 'flat', 'flat-square', 'plastic']).default('for-the-badge'),
  align: z.enum(['left', 'center', 'right']).default('left'),
  includeAttribution: z.boolean().optional(),
});

export const SectionConfigSchema = z.object({
  id: z.string(),
  type: z.string(),
  title: z.string().optional(),
  visible: z.boolean().optional().default(true),
  props: z.object({
    content: z.record(z.unknown()).default({}),
    styles: z.record(z.unknown()).default({}),
    state: z.string().optional(),
  }),
});

export const ReadmeConfigSchema = z.object({
  version: z.string().default('1.0.0'),
  title: z.string().default('MonoForge Profile'),
  settings: SettingsSchema,
  sections: z.array(SectionConfigSchema).default([]),
});

export type ReadmeConfig = z.infer<typeof ReadmeConfigSchema>;
```

## 2. 47 Official Verified Social Platforms

MonoForge includes 47 verified official brand SVG assets in `public/assets/icons/social/<platform>/default.svg`:
- **Development & Code**: `github`, `gitlab`, `codesandbox`, `codepen`, `devto`, `stackoverflow`, `visualstudio`, `leetcode`, `codeforces`, `codechef`, `tryhackme`, `kaggle`, `hashnode`
- **Design & Portfolio**: `behance`, `dribbble`, `unsplash`, `itch`
- **Networking & Socials**: `linkedin`, `twitter`, `x`, `bluesky`, `threads`, `mastodon`, `facebook`, `instagram`, `reddit`, `tiktok`, `linktree`, `medium`
- **Messaging & Community**: `discord`, `telegram`, `slack`, `signal`, `wechat`, `whatsapp`, `matrix`
- **Email & Productivity**: `gmail`, `outlook`, `microsoft-outlook`, `tutanota`
- **Media & Streaming**: `youtube`, `twitch`, `spotify`
- **Monetization & Funding**: `patreon`, `paypal`, `ko-fi`
- **Competitive & Assessments**: `hackerrank`

Each badge supports both icon mode (`format: "icon"`) and badge mode (`format: "badge"` with `for-the-badge`, `flat`, `flat-square`, or `plastic`).

## 4. Telemetry & Visualization SVG API (`/api/telemetry/svg`)

Endpoint: `GET https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/api/telemetry/svg?plugin=<id>&user=<github_handle>&theme=<theme>`

- **Supported Themes (`theme`)**: `emerald`, `matrix`, `cyberpunk`, `tokyonight`, `amber`, `slate`, `ocean`
- **Optional Mode (`mode`)**: `live` or `sample` (defaults to live GitHub GraphQL/REST lookup with explicit provenance badge `LIVE GITHUB`, `SAMPLE DATA`, `PARTIAL DATA`, or `DATA UNAVAILABLE`).
- **Telemetry & Storytelling Plugins (`plugin`)**:
  - `diagonal-heatmap` (aliases: `diagonalheatmap`, `contrib-heatmap`, `contribheatmap`) — 53x7 staggered CSS diagonal sweep heatmap + streak/peak footer
  - `whoami` (aliases: `info-card`, `infocard`) — Neofetch terminal info card pairable beside an ASCII portrait SVG
  - `city` (aliases: `commitcity`, `skyline`) — 3D isometric commit city skyline
  - `isocalendar` (aliases: `calendar`, `iso`) — 3D isometric contribution calendar
  - `heatmap` (`contributions`, `matrix`), `velocity` (`momentum`), `languages` (`langs`), `habits` (`rhythm`), `achievements` (`trophies`)
  - `river` (`commitriver`), `languageriver` (`polyglot`), `yearclock` (`radial`), `pulse` (`ekg`), `radar` (`engineeringradar`), `blueprint` (`schematic`), `timeline` (`releasetimeline`), `solarsystem` (`techstack`), `synthwave` (`outrun`, `bento`), `neofetch` (`fastfetch`, `asciiterminal`), `dna`, `galaxy`, `constellation`, `snake`, `terminal`
  - Plus any registered ID in `ALL_VISUALIZATION_IDS` (30 total) and standalone cards: `leetcode`, `music`, `pagespeed`, `stamp`.

## 5. Studio Workflows (Visualizer 6-Act Story, Terminal Kit, Project README, Assets)

- **6-Act Contribution Story (`/en/visualizer` -> `6-Act Story` tab)**: Pure HTML5 Canvas `draw(ctx, w, h, t)` animations (`drawStoryGrid`, `drawStorySkyline`, `drawStoryPulse`, `drawStoryRing`, `drawStoryStreak`, `drawStoryTerminal`) with `IntersectionObserver`, `t = Infinity` reduced-motion mode, and GitHub 5-green ramp toggle.
- **Terminal Profile Kit & ASCII Portrait (`/en/animator` -> `Terminal Kit` tab)**: Converts uploaded portraits into monochrome ASCII SVGs (`ASCII_DENSITY_RAMP`, CSS `rowWipe` animation), builds `whoami` + diagonal heatmap pairs, and outputs self-hosted `scripts/fetch-github.mjs` (`data/github.json`) + GitHub Action YAML.
- **Project README Studio (`/en/project-readme`)**: `POST /api/project-readme/inspect` parses live GitHub repo metadata and manifests (`package.json`, `pyproject.toml`, `Cargo.toml`, `go.mod`, `Dockerfile`, `.env.example`) into 9 editable tabs.
- **Asset & Sticker Vault (`/en/assets`)**: Searchable directory of 53 protected core vector SVGs and community stickers.

## 6. URL Hydration & Deep-Linking

### Full Profile Config Hydration (`/en/developer?config=...`)
Encode a `ReadmeConfig` JSON payload using UTF-8 safe base64:
```javascript
const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(config));
const binString = Array.from(bytes, (b) => String.fromCodePoint(b)).join('');
const encoded = btoa(binString);
const url = `https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/en/developer?config=${encodeURIComponent(encoded)}`;
```

### Archetype Preview Deep-Link (`/en/templates?template=<id>`)
Share or open any of the 330 curated archetypes directly:
```text
https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/en/templates?template=01-minimal-professional
```

### Live User Personalization (`?user=<github_handle>`)
Pass `?user=<handle>` to `/en/developer?user=<handle>` or `/en/visualizer?user=<handle>` to pre-populate the target GitHub handle.
